sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Db/Ab]My heart is weak and poor until it amaster [Ebm/Bb]find;
[Ab]It has [Db/Ab]no spring of action [Ab/Eb]sure, it [Db/F]varies [Db7/B]with the [Bbm]wind.
[Db/Ab]It cannot [Gb/Db]freely move till Thou [Bbm]has wrought [Fm/C]its chain;
[Ebm/Bb]Enslave it [Db/Ab]with Thy matchless love, and deathless [Ebm/Gb]it [Db/F]shall reign.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Db/Ab]My will is not my own till Thou hast made [Ebm/Bb]it Thine;
[Ab]If it [Db/Ab]would reach a monarch's [Ab/Eb]throne, it [Db/F]must its [Db7/B]crown resign;
[Ebm/Bb]When on Thy [Db/Ab]bosom it has leant, and found [Ebm/Gb]in Thee [Db/F]its life.
